ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In a two-component mixture, the initial mass fraction of solute A is 25%. At the operating temperature, the solubility curve of solute A is as shown in the figure: $\lt img="q_00409_001.png"\gt$ A single-stage extraction method is used; after adding solvent S, the mass fraction of solute A in the obtained extract liquid is $Y_{EA}$ = 40%. Within this operating range, the distribution coefficient of solute A is $K_{A}$ = 1.0. Find the mass fraction $X_{RA}$ of solute A in the raffinate liquid after this extraction process.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is an A-B-S triangular liquid-liquid equilibrium phase diagram, with the upper-left vertex as A, the lower-left vertex as B, and the lower-right vertex as S. The left vertical scale represents the mass fraction of solute A, from 0 to 1.0; the bottom scale represents the mass fraction of solvent S. There is an arched boundary curve of the two-liquid-phase region in the figure; several conjugate phase points are marked on both sides of the curve and connected by tie lines slanting downward to the right. Near the right boundary there is an extract phase point E, and near the left boundary there is a raffinate phase point R; after the equilibrium tie line passing through E is extended to the left boundary, it corresponds to R. Reasoning: The problem gives that the mass fraction of A in the extract liquid is Y_EA=40%, and the distribution coefficient K_A=1.0; according to the graphical method, locate the extract-phase equilibrium point E in the phase diagram. Then follow the equilibrium tie line passing through E to find the other-end raffinate phase point R. Read from point R toward the left-side A mass fraction scale; the corresponding value on the diagram is about 0.16, namely the mass fraction of solute A in the raffinate liquid is X_RA≈0.16.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：识别该图为 A-B-S 三角液液平衡相图，左侧纵向刻度为溶质 A 的质量分数，曲线为双液相区边界，曲线两侧对应萃余相和萃取相，图中有联结线连接共轭相点。根据文字给出的 Y_EA=40% 和 K_A=1.0，在图上定位萃取相平衡点 E；然后沿经过 E 的平衡联结线找到另一端的萃余相点 R；最后从 R 点向左侧 A 质量分数刻度读数，得到 X_RA≈0.16。
